title: Binance Options RFQ Adds SOLUSDT Options
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that SOLUSDT Options has been added to  Binance Options RFQ . Users can now seamlessly trade SOLUSDT Options in a streamlined fashion with instant and competitive prices on Binance Options RFQ.  Explore Binance Options RFQ today! Please note:   SOLUSDT Options are European-style options contracts. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  For more information about Binance Options RFQ, please refer to this  FAQ  &  Guide . There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. About Binance Options RFQ: Binance Options RFQ allows users to submit a Request for Quote (RFQ) for options trades directly with the Binance OTC Trading Desk. Users may leverage Options RFQ’s institutional-grade liquidity, and complete large-sized options trades over-the-counter at competitive prices.  Guides & Related Materials: Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Options RFQ Options RFQ: How To Get Started Thank you for your support!
